book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: Aouda and Fix stayed at the station.
The snow falling, night coming.
And the train, with a new engine, was about to leave.
And the conductor said: we cannot wait.
And Aouda said: I stay.
And Fix said: and I too.
And the train left.
And Fix sat on a bench, and thought.

sentences.ar: قال فيكس بقلبه: هاد الرجل عم يضيع رهانه عشان خادم.
sentences.en: Fix said to himself: this man is losing his wager for a servant.
And will miss the New York steamer.
And lose twenty thousand.
A thief?
And said: I am mad.
Or he is.
And then said: but the warrant is in London.
And I must get him to London.
And what happens after is no matter to me.

sentences.ar: وطول الليل، عودا واقفة عالباب، تتطلع بالتلج.
sentences.en: And all night, Aouda stood at the door, looking at the snow.
She did not sleep.

sentences.ar: وبالصبح، صار صوت طخ من بعيد.
sentences.en: And in the morning, there was shooting from afar.
And then, nothing.
And then, in the snow, black dots.
The soldiers.
And Fogg at their head.
And beside him Passepartout, and the other prisoners.

sentences.ar: عودا ركضت، ومسكت إيد فوغ، وما قدرت تحكي.
sentences.en: Aouda ran, took Fogg's hand, and could not speak.
And Passepartout said: master, you...
And Fogg said: the train?
Fix said: gone.
Since yesterday.
Fogg said: and the next?
Fix said: this evening.
And Fogg calculated.
The New York steamer leaves on the 11th in the evening.
And it is now the 7th in the morning.
And the train needs four days.
So we will not make it.

sentences.ar: وفيكس قال: يا سيد فوغ، في طريقة.
sentences.en: And Fix said: Mr. Fogg, there is a way.
